    I made a new shelf because I didn’t like any of the ones I saw online. It seems like any furniture that doesn’t look like it’s from ikea is incredibly expensive, made incredibly cheap, or incredibly ugly. I ended up making something reasonably priced, cheap looking, and bearably ugly. I still like it because I made it, but this definitely needs a version 2.

    price breakdown:

    fasteners - 9.78

    more fasteners - 9.49

    paint - 14.20

    even more fasteners - 6.85

    paint + fasteners - 15.45

    fasteners - 5.52

    tubes - 53.19

    total of $114.48
